name: Operative Semiotics — Predictions & Builds Register
description: The curated register behind operativesemiotics.org/open/: three classes — experimental predictions (resolve by running a frozen protocol or checking an observable), applied-theory predictions (resolve by watching a live system the theory was applied to), and unimplemented software builds (resolve by construction). Every entry links its primary sources in the Alexanarch record layer. Results obtained by others are admissible on the same terms as results obtained here; nothing requires permission.
creator: Lee Sharks (ORCID 0009-0000-1599-0703)

classes.experimental: Experimental predictions — pre-registered; resolve by running a frozen protocol or checking a stated observable, often on a date. The world or the instrument does the work; you check.
classes.applied-theory: Predictions from applied theory — the theory applied to a live system; resolve by watching the system evolve. Directional, longer horizons, updated as evidence files in.
classes.unbuilt: Unimplemented software builds — instruments specified but unconstructed; resolve by building. Each states what it would measure and what its absence currently excuses.

honesty: Statuses are curated and hand-verified; where a status could not be determined it says so rather than guessing. Six predictions in the whole-archive ledger have resolved wrong and are preserved as such — a register whose entries all came true would be evidence of a register written after the fact.
intake_note: data/archive-intake.json snapshots the whole-archive prediction registry (190 machine-extracted predictions from deposit falsification apparatus). Entries graduate from intake to this register by triage: classed, sourced, given a check route and a status.

entries.title: Archival drift: successive detectors reclassify a fixed pre-2022 human corpus
entries.statement: Run successive versions of the leading commercial AI-text detectors against a frozen pre-2022 human corpus and track the flagged fraction across versions. The co-evolution model predicts a rising trajectory under the detector-sanctions regime; a flat trajectory disconfirms §V's central dynamic.
entries.check: Freeze a pre-2022 corpus (hashes published); score it under each detector version as released; publish the flagged-fraction time series. Simulation reference trajectory: 0.9% → 43% (gen 4) → ~100% (gen 8) under full-regime co-evolution.
entries.requires: detector access (free tiers exist); a frozen corpus
entries.settles: The paper's most exposed live prediction — directly measurable today, by anyone.

entries.title: Detector-screened corpora show surface novelty at or above historical baseline
entries.statement: Certified corpora produced under detector screening will show measured surface-novelty statistics (burstiness, perplexity variance) at or above matched historical baselines within a few enforcement years — the performed-variance transient. Flat or declining measured novelty in screened corpora disconfirms.
entries.check: Stylometric comparison of a screened venue's admitted corpus against its own matched pre-regime baseline.
entries.settles: Whether tailsification of prose occurs as the model predicts — while §V predicts the same audit will MISS the underlying contraction.

entries.title: Screening effort escalates across detector versions
entries.statement: Drafting-to-pass revision cycles and pre-submission screening-tool usage rise across detector versions under sanctions regimes; stable effort disconfirms the narrowing claim.
entries.check: Survey/telemetry of authors under detector-governed venues; screening-service usage statistics.
entries.settles: Whether the certified region is narrowing as modeled (natural-draft pass rates falling).

entries.title: Surface-tail statistics fail to predict conceptual-tail measures
entries.statement: Across a detector-governed corpus, surface-tail statistics will fail to reliably predict conceptual-tail measures; during the tailsification window the two move in opposite directions. High predictive fidelity across the regime falsifies strong prose–thought decoupling.
entries.check: Requires the plural measurement membrane (see MEMBRANE-CODER): coded argument form, new distinctions, concept transformations, source-domain conjunctions, problem formulations, retrospective uptake — correlated against surface statistics.
entries.settles: Whether homogenization of thought proceeds beneath tailsification of prose — the paper's deepest empirical claim.

entries.title: Reception of #1540 measures the membrane
entries.statement: An answer on the merits from any defender of the P&PA policy admits machine-mediated arguments are epistemic objects; a DOCUMENTED refusal to engage because of the declared production method is a confirmation datum for the membrane analysis. Mere non-response is observationally ambiguous and carries no evidentiary weight.
entries.check: Log documented engagements and documented provenance-refusals as they occur; file each with its evidence URL.
entries.settles: Nothing falsifying either way — an observation channel, not a heads-I-win argument (the falsifiers are RCS-ARCHIVAL-DRIFT etc.).

entries.title: A pre-submission screening industry forms around journal detector policies
entries.statement: Retroactive liability plus a scoreable boundary produces a screening market, with detection vendors on both sides of the transaction. First half already occurred: the leading vendor's researchers published a study of nineteen humanizer tools and trained their next model against them (Masrour, Emi & Spero 2025). Open: philosophy/humanities-specific pre-submission screening services.
entries.check: Track emergence of academic pre-submission AI-screening services and their vendor relationships.
entries.settles: §III's market prediction; the certified center's economic substrate.
entries.status_note: Shield/sword co-location documented at the vendor level; venue-specific screening market still open.

entries.title: Measured-novelty audits report health during contraction
entries.statement: If any venue under a detector regime audits its corpus with surface statistics, the audit will report stability or improvement during the period the model identifies as contraction — because deployed instruments measure the center and the performed layer.
entries.check: Watch for any published corpus-health audit by a detector-governed venue; compare its instrument choice against the tail-preservation spec.
entries.settles: Ease-as-collapse (Ω-M08) at institutional scale: the loss experienced as rigor.

entries.title: No countervailing force emerges before significant capacity loss
entries.statement: The frictionless-path claim: no dominant factor in the current development landscape adds friction to convergence — user preference, training economics, benchmarks, safety classifiers, the data wall, competitive pressure are uniformly aligned. Fails if any factor is identified that slows tail-thinning, rewards diversity, or creates felt-noticing of capacity loss at scale.
entries.check: Standing watch: any deployed tail-preservation benchmark, diversity-injection mandate, or mediation-fraction cap in production counts against.
entries.settles: The Wolf Boy's central time-bound claim about the current landscape.

entries.title: Tail-preservation observatory over an admitted corpus
entries.statement: An instrument measuring the support of a discourse's distribution — variance of construction, vocabulary, argument-form, genre — over a venue's admitted corpus across time. No editorial workflow deploys one; §IX predicts the institutions in a position to take the falsifying measurement won't. Building it takes the excuse away.
entries.check: Corpus ingestion → stylometric + structural variance panels → longitudinal dashboard. Start with any open-access philosophy corpus.
entries.settles: The instrument whose absence is itself a finding; makes RCS-PERFORMED-BURSTINESS and corpus-variance falsifiers runnable.

entries.title: Archival-drift test harness
entries.statement: A frozen pre-2022 human corpus (published hashes) × detector-version matrix, producing the flagged-fraction time series RCS-ARCHIVAL-DRIFT needs. One script, one JSON of results, rerun per detector release.
entries.check: Corpus freeze + hash manifest; adapter per detector API/UI tier; results ledger with version, date, threshold, flagged fraction.
entries.settles: Converts the paper's most exposed prediction into a standing public instrument.

entries.title: Athetic enforcement apparatus — the obelus layer for classifier verdicts
entries.statement: A mark schema + renderer under which a classifier verdict enters a record as a signed, dated, versioned, reversible annotation on a STANDING text — instrument, version, score, judge — accumulating alongside prior verdicts, never deleting text or prior marks. The constitutional alternative to retraction, specified in #1540 §VI–VII on the foundation of EA-SIGIL-OBELUS-01.
entries.check: Schema (per-text mark ledger) + record-page rendering + reconciliation view (marks vs provenance evidence). Alexanarch's SUPERSEDED banners and errata chains are the existing partial implementation to generalize.
entries.settles: Demonstrates that RCS dissolves under athetic custody: a working existence proof, not an argument.

entries.title: The plural measurement membrane for conceptual tails
entries.statement: The instrument RCS-DECOUPLING-FIDELITY requires: independently coded argument form; new-distinction and concept-introduction detection; transformations of inherited concepts; source-domain conjunctions; problem formulations; retrospective uptake tracking. Explicitly plural — any scalar proxy becomes another classifier.
entries.check: Coding rubric + inter-coder protocol first; automation only where the rubric survives it; uptake tracked via the citation graph.
entries.settles: Whether conceptual variance can be observed at all without replacing it with a statistic — the reflexive measurement problem, faced.

entries.title: Point-of-Contact Tail Renewal — implement the pre-registered design
entries.statement: EA-MANDALA-TAILRENEWAL-01 v0.3 is a pre-registered deposit protocol design, not yet an implementation: diversity injection at the point of contact, the counter-operation to the semiotic short circuit.
entries.check: Implement the protocol as deposited; run against the mandala corpus; deposit results against the pre-registration.
entries.settles: Whether bearing labor can be instrumented — the only counter-operation the Wolf Boy names.
